statistics.selection_scope: post-hoc exploratory; existing cohort, not prospective holdout

permission_boundary: Separate explicit user permission for these seven logical calls on saved real native32. --execute is opt-in, not proof. No approval ID, grant or permission-file required.

hypotheses.primary: H0: mu_PR >= C_XDF8; H1: mu_PR < C_XDF8
hypotheses.secondary: CDF8: same single PR mean interval, nested larger fixed threshold; no separate p-value/test

policy_reason.confidence: Reuse the existing 95% two-sided R32 one-sample interval; one-sided lower alternative alpha=.025 uses exactly its upper endpoint (97.5% one-sided confidence), not alpha=.05.
policy_reason.precision: Reuse current near-practical native32 5% halfwidth fraction and skew2/influence.25 diagnostics; fixed lower XDF total is the primary denominator. No 1%/0.5% larger-cohort claim transferred.
policy_reason.secondary: All difference/ratio intervals are affine images of one univariate PR total interval. No second sampling variance/calibration, no second hypothesis test or unnecessary alpha splitting.
policy_reason.selection: Post-hoc exploratory design after seeing saved point prices. No prospective/pre-registration/independent-holdout claim for this hypothesis.

accounting.W: Saved fixed W, applied once; do not multiply by r32, N32 or 13 rounds.
accounting.shell: Saved head/X/Y serial shell applied once.
accounting.calibration: One cohort reused across fixed RPE rounds and both deterministic thresholds, not 13 or 26 independent calibrations.
accounting.denominator: XDF/CDF deterministic saved P0 prices in this model, no artificial sampling variance.
accounting.lane: ideal_exact_native only; finite-bit native mean as proxy, ideal-law cost transfer unqualified; evidence/assumed lanes preserved and not promoted.

qualification.interval: Approximate fixed-N IID Student-t; coverage unvalidated, PCG64 finite-bit streams not mathematical IID proof.
qualification.generality: No extension beyond fixed H4/1.00A/STO3G/sector36/rank8/s1/h.1/m0..12, PR LD2/r32/K0 and fixed saved XDF/CDF, own-DF oracle, preparation excluded.
qualification.adoption: No formal scientific review, novelty, objective-only causal effect or paper GO.

decision_policy.primary: Prefix existing price_statistics decision with POSTHOC_EXPLORATORY_; p=.025 rejection agrees with upper95%<XDF. Boundary inconsistency unresolved.
decision_policy.unresolved: Zero observed variance: null CI/p; incomplete or nonfinite input: correctness FAIL/STOP. Precision/diagnostic failure retains estimates and all observations but unresolved label.
decision_policy.secondary: Shared interval may support CDF even if XDF sign unresolved, provided primary precision/diagnostics and test/CI consistency pass; not an independent confirmation.

call_derivation.meaning: Read fixed small JSON metadata; not numerical recomputation.
Bind candidate/SOURCE/STOP/common ideal scope and saved accounting scalars.
Read exactly 32 existing six-file native JSON packets; zero new trajectories.
Audit sample ids/seed/cohort/K0 events/correctness/journal and integer metrics; no moments.
One composite primary inference: reused calibration/t CI/diagnostics plus SciPy one-sample lower-tail p and endpoint consistency.
Affine fixed-CDF difference/ratio and shared-bound label from same PR interval; no t-test.
Summarize conditional exploratory qualifications and provenance.

stop_rules: Fresh run01 only. Retry=resume=0. Passive audit is read-only and consumes no scientific calls.
First SOURCE/input/candidate/cohort/correctness mismatch: retain partial evidence and STOP; no trimming/replacement/reweighting.
Scientific numerical calls may start only after separate user permission for the fixed contract; do not automatically execute during preparation.
Normal completion, unresolved statistical decision or failure: mandatory STOP; no sampling extension, prospective cohort, transfer or review.

resources.strategy: Small saved JSON and one dependent 32-row scalar inference; existing array-aware calibration reused. No heavy kernel, GPU or compile. Sequential chain avoids launching dependent work after correctness FAIL.
resources.noninterference: Task-local output only; shared environments/cache/jobs and old SOURCE/raw/contracts/grants/ledger/marker/STOP untouched.
